    • getCommandTiming

      public static Timing getCommandTiming(String pluginName, Command command)

      Due to access restrictions, we need a helper method to get a Command TimingHandler with String group

      由于访问限制，我们需要一个辅助方法来获取带字符串分组的命令 TimingHandler

      Plugins should never call this 插件绝不应调用此方法
      参数:
      pluginName - Plugin this command is associated with 此命令所关联的插件
      command - Command to get timings for 要获取计时的命令
      返回:
      TimingHandler TimingHandler

    • getPluginByClassloader

      public static Plugin getPluginByClassloader(Class<?> clazz)
      Looks up the class loader for the specified class, and if it is a PluginClassLoader, return the Plugin that created this class. 查找指定类的类加载器，如果它是 PluginClassLoader，则返回创建此类的插件。
      参数:
      clazz - Class to check 要检查的类
      返回:
      Plugin if created by a plugin 若由插件创建则为该插件
